name: Stytch
description: Stytch's hosted server manages projects, redirect URLs, secrets and other configuration in your Stytch workspace.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (rustic-kilogram-6347.customers.stytch.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
